Name: (AT) Centered Wall Decor for Hallway Fix
Author: KaliRivera
Description:
In lieu of the latest update for my other mod, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/27020]Hallway Fix[/url], now granting the ability to place wall decor on the hallway walls, this Alternative Textures pack consists of various small, 1-tile wide pieces of wall decor converted to 2-tile wide pieces so they can be easily centered on the 2-tile wide hallway walls!

Included pieces as of this current update:
[list]
[*]The calendar and all wall sconces, split into two textures to retain their functionality! Any wall sconce can be utilized for any texture. 
[*]5 textures set to 'Kitemaster 95' - Just some simple lil chicken pictures I made lol
[*]10 textures set to 'Highway 89' - various vanilla textures, plus a double light switch!
[*]8 textures set to 'Pathways' - all 8 of the vanilla movie posters
[/list]
If y'all have any other wall decor pieces you'd like to see added, let me know! 



And if you've ever had your spouse call you a pet name that just gave you the ick ([i]cough cough[/i] "ducky"...), or if you're just sick of seeing the same dialogue every time you get a Stardrop from your spouse, please check out my other mod [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/27337]Custom Spouse Pet Names and Stardrop Dialogue[/url]!
